messages:
lucy: Noticing a recurring incident shape in recent postmortems: KV eviction burst -> token p95 jump -> autoscaler flip. Opening thread to finalize runbook/playbook edits and owners.

ben: Short checklist + copy/paste commands would be great so on-call doesn't guess. Also propose an explicit playbook escalation ladder.

anya: I can own the runbook edits. Plan: add a one-line "First responder" at top, an Immediate Mitigations block with exact `redwoodctl` commands, and an Escalation Ladder with numeric thresholds. Creating ticket RW-5340.

ben: Here are the operator commands we used last time (paste-friendly):
```
# check eviction and p95
curl -sS "https://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=kv_cache_eviction_rate[1m]"
curl -sS "https://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=token_latency_p95"
# quick mitigation: reduce batch size on pool 'serve-core'
redwoodctl deploy --pool serve-core --set batch_size=4 --note "temp-RW-5340"
# pin to low-mem variant for 15m
redwoodctl route set --model core-api --variant lowmem-v2 --duration 15m --note "postmortem-RW-5340"
# rollback canary if needed
redwoodctl rollout rollback --model core-api --to-version stable
```

lucy: Suggested playbook thresholds: notify on eviction_rate > 2% for 3m; page eng-oncall on eviction_rate > 5% for 5m OR token_p95 > 1s; escalate to infra-lead on sustained autoscaler oscillation. Also require tagging any temp routing/pin changes with `postmortem-<ticket>`.

infra-bot: InfraBot: ticket RW-5340 created and assigned to @anya. Due date set to 2026-06-10.

anya: I'll add the one-line Quick Triage: "1) check eviction+p95; 2) apply quick mitigations (batch/variant); 3) notify owners; 4) page if thresholds hit." Will include owner matrix (who pins, who routes, who scales) and a short verification step (check hit_ratio up within 10m). Draft PR by EOD tomorrow.

lucy: Action items:
- anya: runbook/playbook edits (RW-5340) — due 2026-06-10
- ben: add ops snippet to ops-docs and link to runbook — due EOD today
- lucy: finalize escalation thresholds in monitoring — due 72h

ben: ack, will post PR link when done.

lucy: Thanks all. We'll run a 20-min tabletop with oncall after PR merges to validate the Quick Triage flow. If RW-5340 stalls, tag infra-eng-lead. :white_check_mark:
